sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner

sup:70410.subject: Firm two-year commitment proposal - mechanical seal 24 mm
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to secure our full need through a firm commitment. Our proposal is EUR 29.00/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, 24 months and a 56-day lead time. Delivery is DAP, payment is 30 days net, and the package would be effective 2027-01-01. This is below the current price of EUR 29.89. If the package is agreed, the full annual quantity is binding.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); this is not a claim about your actual cost or margin.

If this package needs approval as a commercial exception, would you be willing to sponsor it with your manager? We would gladly support your internal business case with this firm commitment.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Firm two-year commitment proposal - mechanical seal 24 mm
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should-cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your request for a 24-month commitment and increased volume. Based on the revised parameters, we can offer EUR 31.70 per unit. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our current offer comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

sup:70410.subject: Revised package: full volume, three-year commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation. To answer your question: we can commit to the full 23,400 pcs per year on a binding basis.

We are raising our proposed price by EUR 1.00 to EUR 30.00/unit, and we are adding a third committed year. The package is 23,400 pcs/year, 36 months and a 56-day lead time, with delivery DAP, payment 30 days net and an effective date of 2027-01-01.

Your supplier-wide rolling on-time delivery was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3); we ask for commercial recognition of this service record in the package.

We have moved on price and added a third year. Could you reciprocate with a price concession of your own? We would conclude on this complete package. If it needs internal approval on your side, we would appreciate you taking it forward.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Revised package: full volume, three-year commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your commitment to the full volume and the extension to a 36-month contract term. The delivery record you cited has been reviewed; however, it does not warrant a commercial concession. 

In exchange for the 36-month term, we reduce our price to EUR 31.50 per unit. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer covers a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. The offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.
